title: Spoke return (spoke -> coordinator)
description: A spoke's final report: exactly one fenced ```json block with nothing outside it. Checked by hooks before it reaches the coordinator. The schema checks shape only; the coordinator still re-runs the checks and compares git diff with files_changed.

status.description: success = the job is done (read-only agents: the checks ran, whatever they found). failure = you could not do the job.

agent.description: Your agent name exactly as in your definition. Checked against the agent that ran.

base_sha.description: `git rev-parse HEAD` before you changed anything. Must equal the brief's base_sha.

head_sha.description: The commit holding your work. Required (non-null) for an implementation spoke's success; null for read-only agents.

summary.description: One paragraph: what was actually produced. Never claim success with a stubbed deliverable.

files_changed.description: Every file created, modified or deleted, by any means (Edit, Write or a Bash command). Empty for read-only agents.

phase.description: red = the failing test before the fix; green = after; gate = the final full checks.

summary.description: e.g. '18 passed', or the failing assertion.

tests_run.description: Every check you actually executed, in order, with its real result.

contract_gaps.description: Where the given interfaces were insufficient. [] if none.

brief_defects.description: Where the brief itself was wrong: a stale fact, a path that doesn't exist, a rubric that contradicts the code. [] if none.

findings.description: Defects found. For reviewer this is the deliverable. Implementation spokes report defects outside their scope here instead of fixing them.

failure_type.description: Why the job could not be done. (malformed-return is assigned only by the coordinator.)

retryable.description: true if the same brief could succeed on a re-run; false if the brief or an input must change first.

attempted.description: What was tried, with exact commands.

alternatives.description: What to try next, or what the coordinator should change in the brief.

owner.description: The agent whose territory it is in, or 'coordinator'.

evidence.description: Command output, a failing input, or a quote of the code.
